risks.risk: Internal frame damage or sagging springs.
risks.proof: A video clip of a person sitting firmly on different sections of the sofa to check for noise or excessive sinkage.
risks.if_unproven: As having a compromised or weakened internal frame.

risks.risk: Damage, tears, or heavy staining on the back side.
risks.proof: A photo of the sofa pulled away from the wall showing the entire back panel.
risks.if_unproven: As having significant cosmetic damage to the rear fabric.

risks.risk: Structural instability of the metal legs.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the points where the gold legs meet the sofa frame.
risks.if_unproven: As having loose or potentially unstable legs.

risks.proof: A high-definition video walkthrough with bright lighting to check for subtle fabric discoloration.
risks.if_unproven: As requiring professional deep-cleaning and sanitization.

proof_requests: Photos and witness confirmation of the 2-seater couch mentioned in the description.
A photo of the back of the 3-seater sofa.
Exact dimensions (length, width, and height) of the sofa.
A video showing the underside of the sofa to inspect the frame and leg attachments.
response.reason: The seller claims a 2-seater is included in the deal, but the witness only reported a single 3-seater. Dimensions and the condition of the missing unit are essential for a baseline valuation.
